gloss: I'm sorry to trouble you; thank you very much (humble)

definitions.gloss: I'm sorry to trouble you; excuse me for bothering you
definitions.explanation: A humble expression used when making a request or causing inconvenience.

definitions.gloss: thank you very much; I'm much obliged
definitions.explanation: A humble expression of gratitude when someone has done something for you.

examples.japanese: {恐|おそ}れ{入|い}りますが、もう{一度|いちど}{説明|せつめい}していただけますか。
examples.english: I'm sorry to trouble you, but could you explain that once more?

examples.japanese: {恐|おそ}れ{入|い}りますが、{少々|しょうしょう}お{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: I'm sorry, but please wait a moment.

examples.japanese: わざわざお{越|こ}しいただき、{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります。
examples.english: Thank you so much for taking the trouble to come.

examples.japanese: ご{配慮|はいりょ}いただき、{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります。
examples.english: I'm very grateful for your consideration.

examples.japanese: {恐|おそ}れ{入|い}りますが、こちらにご{署名|しょめい}をお{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I'm sorry to trouble you, but please sign here.

examples.japanese: お{忙|いそが}しいところ{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}りますが、{確認|かくにん}をお{願|ねが}いできますか。
examples.english: I know you're busy, but could I ask you to check this?

notes:
FORMALITY:
This is a very polite/humble expression commonly used in business settings and customer service. The past form {恐|おそ}れ{入|い}りました is also used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}りますが〜 - I'm sorry to trouble you, but... (preceding a request)
・お{忙|いそが}しいところ{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}りますが - I know you're busy, but...
・わざわざ〜{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります - Thank you for going out of your way to...

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません - I'm terribly sorry (apologizing for trouble caused)
・{失礼|しつれい}いたします - Excuse me (more general)
